svg.title: The Mathesis tech tree
svg.desc: Generated by scripts/ultraplan/ultraplan.mjs from docs/ultraplan/tree.jsonl. 52 nodes in 8 eras; each arrow runs from a node to a node it enables.
svg.text: each arrow: this enables that · gold border: start it now · ✅ done 🔨 active 🌱 open ⛔ blocked 🍂 dropped

g.title: APP-1 to APP-4: missing stays missing: Missing inputs propagate and never read as zero; the cash identity; the least funding gap; status never upgrades. Each proved in Agda, Rocq and Lean.
Atlas views: The catalogue and the A to Z and organisation views, generated from the census rows and checked for staleness by `just check-views`.
Bridges by construction: Generate the Agda, Rocq and Lean forms of a statement from one source (Q-2.3, E-2.3), so a re-proof starts from a statement known to match.
Bridge candidates: Three unassessed candidate links between theorems in different repositories and provers (tropical MaxPlus, resource-algebra M-2, squeakwell). Candidates, not evidence.
Bridge lock pilot: The full bridge record for two pilots, a squeakwell ladder row and resource-algebra to tropical-types (WO 5.2, ruling D-7 a): what is claimed equal, by which map, checked how.
Census of the estate: The proof census of 465 public repositories: 249 rows of proof files, holes and axioms, each at a pinned commit and time.
Census on a schedule: A scheduled census workflow as the one writer of the census rows (WO 5.3), so refreshes stop arriving by hand and unrecorded.
Centre computations: Over locked bridges: classes under a criterion, their order, contradictions, and the five different absences (RA 786-801).

Is a chain enough? (X-PF1): Experiment X-PF1, pre-registered: list each rule, gate and report in the estate that reads a status token (at least the proof-route ABI, the registry and ledger rule 3) and ask whether its result changes between the two members of a fibre. Outcome A, B or C (or D: two tokens the wrong way round) decides the order.
CI records its own runs: A trusted publisher that writes each green run's ledger rows to the repository, so no human copies rows. The piece standards PR 1675 leaves open.
Claims registry: Pins 53 claims in their home repositories and derives each grade from the home receipt with the pinned canon reader. No grade is typed.
Cohort model in Agda: The cohort-economics model of the applied shelf, with three number modes and synthetic examples generated into Agda from JSON Lines.
Concept commons: The horizon of the atlas (M4): a commons of the estate's concepts, navigable by A to Z, subject (MSC2020), project and provenance.
Propose and dispose corpus: A corpus as a view over bridges and receipts (E-H.1), and 20 ungraded Agda theorems given model-proposed Rocq and Lean legs, kept BRIDGE-PENDING until checked (E-H.2).
Transport through Dedukti: Check an Agda proof in Rocq and Lean by translating it through Dedukti and Lambdapi instead of re-proving it, the route PROOF-POLICY section 2 puts first.

Mend the status documents: ROADMAP, PROOF-NEEDS, README and the intend contract contradict the receipts (PWG-1 vs PWG-2ii, receipts called planned that exist, stage states). Make each agree with the derived facts.

Theorem dossier: The eight-item dossier for each theorem (Line 0), scored first on THY-1, five januskey theorems and two each of secret-types and lintel (E-0). Its home (here or standards, R-5) is still open.
Echo mirror records: Bridge records for the six languages that mirror echo-types (E-2.5), with the graded-comonad disagreement kept as an open question.
Closed list of encoding differences: A closed, tested list of the ways the same statement differs between Agda, Rocq and Lean (Q-2.1), built from the existing comparisons as bridge records (E-2.1).
PWG-2ii across the estate: The long horizon (Q-H.3): the 900 and more ungraded theorems of the estate each carry two checked recheck legs. The question is whether that takes months or years.
File the transport reproducers: File the THY-1 reproducers upstream (E-2.4): the Agda2Dedukti crash and option gaps, and Lambdapi dropping rules. Filing is the owner's act.
Thirteen-week forecast: A synthetic thirteen-week cash forecast on the proved cohort model (E-4.1), the first worked decision of the applied shelf.
Maths panel in GELS: A panel in GELS, the estate display, for the maths: the frontier of this tree, the grade census with its denominator, and the open decisions.
Generated Idris2 token laws: Generate the Idris2 token laws of the proof-route Token module from S-1 (E-3.2), so the engineering side cites the theorem instead of restating it.
Theorem to code: januskey: Follow one theorem into running code (E-3.1): the januskey slice T-1, with T-10 open and G-2 assumed, and a composite status for the whole (Q-3.1).
Liquidity shelf: The liquidity part of the applied shelf: a forecast whose every verdict carries its proof status, from synthetic data only.
Paper: receipts, not claims: A methods paper: proof status derived from machine receipts, graded by witness count, never typed, with the registry as a working instance across an estate.
Paper: an algebra of proof status: S-1 to S-3 written up: proof status as a dioid, its monotone evaluation, and the grade as a checked function of the receipt.
Note: feature reachability: A short note on THY-1: why requesting every feature is a sound check for absence, with the three-prover receipt as artefact. Its dependant is a real standards rule.
Proof lanes in a pinned image: Run the three proof lanes in a container image pinned by digest, the condition PROOF-POLICY now sets for PWG-1 (standards#1625). The Guix shell alone does not qualify.
Proof gate in pinned Guix: Agda 2.7.0.1, Rocq 8.18.0 and Lean 4.29.0 check every gated module on every commit, with an axiom audit over theorems and definitions and planted controls that must fail.
Publish the atlas: Deploy the built site (WO 4.3). The hold ran to 2026-11-24; deploying is outward-facing, so it waits for a fresh owner question first.
Back to PWG-1: THY-1 and APP-1 to APP-4 derive PWG-1 again, from receipts whose rows name the pinned image.
Shared receipt generator: Adopt the standards generator: the receipt is generated from a run ledger, and the gate lists each green run's ledger rows. Pull request 122.
Proof receipts: The PROOF-POLICY 8.5.1 receipt of Mathesis: per-leg run, commit, checker, inputs manifest and axioms, checked by the shared git checker and read by the canon reader.

Receipts campaign: Home repositories re-record their receipts (WO 5.1): secret-types and lintel for the reader they fail, resource-algebra for its Lean leg. Takes 12 ungraded theorems towards a grade.
S-1 by reuse of resource-algebra: Prove only the morphism here, and take the dioid laws from resource-algebra's E-1 to E-3 (already PWG-2i) through a locked bridge, instead of proving them again.

S-1: tokens form a dioid: The status tokens form a ResourceAlgebra and dioid with an annihilating zero, with an injective strict morphism into MinMax. Agda against resource-algebra at a pin, re-proved in Rocq and Lean (E-1.1).
S-2: evaluation is monotone: Positive evaluation of status is monotone. It holds for each ordered resource algebra, so it can be proved once against the kernel now, whatever X-PF1 decides (R-3).

S-3: the grade is a function: The Proof Witness Grade is a total monotone function of the receipt, and the canon reader agrees with it on every case, shown by exhaustion as in residual-evidence-types (E-1.3).
g.text: S-3: the grade is a f…

g.title: S-4 and S-5: honest cash verdicts: A sound three-valued cash verdict over intervals, where missing means unbounded (S-4), and more uncertainty never strengthens a verdict (S-5). Reuses residual-evidence-types at a pin; pass is PWG-3 (E-4.2).
Atlas site (build): Renders every generated view with Asciidoctor and fails on any warning or broken link. It builds; it does not deploy.

From oracle to theorem: S-MN and S-DM (the multinomial logit closed form and the DM contrast limit) are tested only, against MetaManifold-WebUI as oracle. Prove them in Agda, Rocq and Lean for admission (Q-2.6).

Keep superseded manifests (option): A generator option in standards that keeps the inputs digest, manifest and axioms on superseded receipts. Mathesis turns it on once it lands (owner ruling 2026-11-24); until then the run ledger keeps each digest.
Talk: an atlas of an estate: A talk on mapping the mathematics of hundreds of repositories, with every status traced to a receipt.
Cohort economics, taught: A worked tutorial: a small business model where missing data stays missing, with the proofs alongside and synthetic data only.
Theory shelf and ledger: The admission rule for theory no single system owns, with an append-only ledger of every grade and receipt change. One theorem admitted so far.

THY-1: reachability is monotone: In a dependency graph with feature-guarded edges, a node unreachable with every feature requested is unreachable under any request. Proved in Agda, re-proved in Rocq and Lean.

Settle the order of status tokens: Record the order X-PF1 decides, in Mathesis (R-1, provisional) and in the canon. Evidence it must answer: R-1 reads PROOF-POLICY section 5 as open < argued < tested-only, resource-algebra E-1 (PWG-2i) proves open < tested-only < argued, and section 5 itself lists the tokens without stating an order.
The ultraplan: This tech tree: data first, with derived eras, frontier, forks, confluences and advisor picks, and a done that must show evidence.
Value of information: Decision science on the shelf: what a missing input is worth to know, computed from the three-valued verdicts. No optimiser (decision-science README).
What is owed: A view of the standards requirements master list beside the census and the registry (WO 5.4): what each repository owes, and what it has.
